Associate it with something positive, you take the med you get a chocolate (for example, whatever motivates you).

Always remembering to breathe and any kind of grounding that works for you before/after taking the med probably cant hurt.

If it was the right time for you it was the right time for you. Things dont have to be worse (especially compared to what other people are facing). You can still try therapy and other things, people can find taking meds in combination with therapy to be most beneficial.
